title: The Ridge-Pass Where Arithmetic Learns to Stop

features.name: the last counting frame
features.desc-on-touch: Wind has polished the beads. You cannot tell if numbers were ever truly here, or if the frame was always just a frame.

features.name: stone's refusal
features.desc-on-touch: The rock knows arithmetic does not stick to its surface. Time erases what the wind cannot.

features.name: the direction that learned it was weather
features.desc-on-touch: It used to measure. Now it only drifts with every breeze, unable to choose between north and nothing.

inscription: where the count looked down and saw the sky would not receive the answer

file.name: Peak_Field_Notes_Trailing_Off_Incomplete.txt
file.note: calculations abandoned midway. the final number was never spoken. the weather spoke instead
